plan_coverage: Only listed plans have full accepted/reference/K/H; no old reconstruction.
raw_binary: r29-current-plan.bin is a current transport buffer, not a history.
substep_clock: Each encoded row: node,substep,before,after,ncontact; pre-state,post-state,rawPD,actuator_force,qfrc_passive,residual; then ncontact*(geom1,geom2,6 contact-frame forces).

r31_schema.model_roles: native geom/pair forward; independent smooth derivatives at native substeps
r31_schema.first_soft_AB: (10,nx*nx+nx*nu): row-major one-step A_s then B_s at native states
r31_schema.scope: Approximate local model, no plant Jacobian or stability claim

r32_search.scope: Last actual numerical attempt for each selected call; partial failed-backward arrays are not valid full Riccati results. Stops with no new attempt retain the prior search identity.
r32_search.gradient: u-clip(u-Qu, original instantaneous target/PD bounds); independent of H/lambda, surrogate only

r33_candidates.full_policy: Each candidate preserves its native accepted rollout and exact reference/actions/times/K/H/feedback scale; JSON planner calls carry selection and high-precision expected/actual descent.
r33_candidates.foot_rows: Each row: time, then FL/FR/RL/RR each geom_xyz,foot_bottom_z,native_world_Fz,proxy_material_Fz,native_contact_count; after mj_step fields refer to its pre-integration node.
r33_candidates.scale_units: D is diagonal Hessian units cost/rad^2; mu is dimensionless.
r33_candidates.scope: Bounded native event windows including non-winners. Missing scale means no matching scale was computed by this call, not a zero matrix.
